title: Automatically discovering heuristics in a complex SAT solver with large language models

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-guided heuristic optimization for complex SAT solvers
mechanism.populationDetail: Algorithm 4 maintains one current solver configuration A and replaces it only with a candidate whose PAR-2 is no worse.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The current best-so-far solver is retained as one incumbent; no separate multi-candidate archive is described.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The incumbent is also the single best-so-far record; these are not separate data structures in the described algorithm.
mechanism.generationDetail: One current solver parent is edited only at selected modularized heuristic functions; selected functions may be rewritten together but all derive from the same incumbent.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: LLM evaluator returns a semantic-redundancy gate; compile/runtime error output is reused for repair, while PAR-2 drives incumbent acceptance.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The parent solver is fixed to incumbent A; random selection of function indices is component selection, not parent selection.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Unsupervised entropy-based automatic optimization of prompt Role/Goal/Tips and complexity-aware modularization of a large solver are central mechanisms not directly represented by the current prompt/generation taxonomy.
